episodes.title: The Sopranos
probes: A family of wild ducks has settled in Tony's backyard pool, and he has been feeding and watching them.
Tony tries to talk his mother into moving to a nursing home, and she will not hear of it.

episodes.title: 46 Long
probes: Paulie and Big Pussy are put to work tracking down whoever stole Anthony Jr.'s teacher's car.
In session, Melfi presses Tony about aiming his anger at Livia at other people instead.

episodes.title: Denial, Anger, Acceptance
probes: Tony sits at his daughter's school choir recital and finds himself in tears during her solo.
A Jewish motel owner brings Tony in to deal with a son-in-law refusing to give up his share.
In session, Melfi asks Tony whether it bothered him to be compared to a monster.

episodes.title: Meadowlands
probes: At Tony's request, a police detective in his debt shadows Melfi through an evening out with a date.

episodes.title: College
probes: Tony drives Meadow from campus to campus on a college tour, the two of them alone on the road.
Tony and his daughter check into a roadside motel partway through their trip out of state.
With Tony away, Carmela has the parish priest over at the house and pours drinks.

episodes.title: Pax Soprana
probes: Tony complains that his medication has flattened his sex drive, and it is wearing on him.
Junior sits as guest of honor at a lavish celebration dinner with the family's capos around the table.

episodes.title: Down Neck
probes: In flashback, young Tony hides in the trunk of his father's car to see where his sister is being taken.
Tony tells Melfi how his father always took his sister along on outings and left him behind.
Tony frets to Melfi that his own genes may have corrupted his son and shaped who the boy becomes.

episodes.title: The Legend of Tennessee Moltisanti
probes: Chris keeps trying and failing to get anywhere with a mob screenplay he is writing.
Melfi and her ex-husband go back and forth over whether she ought to keep treating a certain patient.
Chris, losing patience at a bakery counter, makes a scene over being kept waiting for his order.

episodes.title: Boca
probes: Meadow's soccer coach has been offered a better job elsewhere, and is making plans to leave town.
Tony and Carmela can't resist trading sly, thinly veiled jokes at Junior's expense whenever he's around.
fine: Junior's girlfriend has been happily bragging to her friends about his talents in bed, against his wishes.

episodes.title: A Hit Is a Hit
probes: Tony's neighbor invites him out for a round of golf, where the other men pepper him with questions about mob life.
Chris sits down with a gangster rapper who is tangled up with Hesh over unpaid royalties.
Tony tells Melfi about a boy with a cleft palate he and his childhood friends used to mock.

episodes.title: Isabella
probes: A young Italian exchange student is house-sitting for the neighbours next door while they are away.
Tony drifts into a sunlit old-country daydream of a young woman nursing an infant.
fine: Tony, listless and depressed, spends his days in bed, barely able to rouse himself.

episodes.title: I Dream of Jeannie Cusamano
probes: Carmela confronts the priest about his habit of getting close to lonely, 'spiritually thirsty' married women.
A storm knocks the power out at the Soprano house, so the family goes out for dinner instead.
